body:
**Round 10 done.** Bundle rebuilt, served live at http://127.0.0.1:3100/ (asset `index-BxGmASTN.js`, Last-Modified 02:39:52Z).

**This round:**
- **Inbox.tsx** — 2,777-line most-visited page now mostly translated: 5 tab labels (Mine/Recent/Unread/Blocked/All), 2 search placeholders, Group/Sort/Column-picker/Nesting toolbar titles, mark-all-as-read button + dialog (title + pluralized description + Cancel/Confirm), all 6 category SelectItems + label, all 3 approval-status SelectItems + label, all Retry/Retrying button pairs, all Mark-as-read/Dismiss-from-inbox aria-labels, the templated `New issue in {group}` title+aria.
- **SidebarAgents.tsx** — fixed a round-6 bug where `SidebarAgentItem` was using `t()` before destructuring `useTranslation` (12 tsc errors now resolved).
- 17 new keys added to inbox namespace; en + zh-TW canonical, 38 sibling locales backfilled with English fallback (path A — real translations follow later).

**Commit:** `1497a0c0f` (pushed to `Ericlyh/paperclip:master`).

**Mobile-visible surfaces translated this round (toggle to zh-TW to verify):**
- Inbox tab bar (Mine → 我的, Recent → 最近, Unread → 未讀, Blocked → 已封鎖, All → 全部)
- Inbox search input (`搜尋收件匣…`)
- Inbox toolbar buttons (Group/Sort/Column-picker titles)
- Inbox /all category select (`類別` + `所有類別` / `我最近的議題` / `加入請求` / `審核項目` / `執行失敗` / `警報`)
- Inbox /all approval-status select (`審核狀態` + `所有審核狀態` / `需要處理` / `已解決`)
- Inbox mark-all-as-read dialog (`確定要全部標記為已讀嗎？` + pluralized description + `取消` / `全部標記為已讀`)
- Inbox row buttons: `重試` / `重試中…`, `標記為已讀` / `從收件匣移除` / `關閉` (aria)
- Inbox group new-issue button (`在 {群組} 中新增問題`, aria+title)
- Inbox nesting toolbar (`啟用/停用父子任務巢狀`)

**On your two questions (recap):**
1. *Why upstream?* We don't. Ericlyh is read-only on `paperclipai/paperclip`; we push to the fork and serve from the local working tree. No upstream action needed for any of this work.
2. *Continue translation, mobile-first* — done for round 10 (above). Each round = 1 commit + this comment so you can skim between heartbeats.

**Remaining high-priority mobile surfaces:** IssueDetail (5,457 lines, round 11), MyIssues/Issues, Goals detail, Settings pages, SidebarStarredProjects, CommandPalette, KeyboardShortcutsCheatsheet.

**Verified:** `curl -sI http://127.0.0.1:3100/assets/index-BxGmASTN.js` → 200, 14.8MB. `grep -oE "我最近的議題|所有類別|重試中…|從收件匣移除"` on the served asset → all 4 present.

**Risks / follow-ups:** None blocking. Pre-existing locale-validation failures (38 locales missing `mobileNav` + `dashboard.title`) and 13 tsc errors in test files unrelated to this work. 14 pages + 1 large component still unwired.

**Next-step owner:** you (mobile-check the Inbox tab bar / toolbar / category select / mark-all dialog) → agent continues IssueDetail (round 11) next heartbeat.

**Confidence:** high — tsc clean for both touched files, JSON validated across all 40 locales, bundle verified at the asset-hash level.
